title: Spec: OSCORE packet padding to fixed size classes
description: Define 2-3 OSCORE packet size classes to prevent message-type inference from packet size. All OSCORE-protected messages padded to the nearest class boundary before encryption. Proposed classes: small (64 bytes), medium (128 bytes), large (224 bytes — near LoRa MTU). Add to spec/06-security.md. Low cost (wastes some airtime on padding) but eliminates size-based traffic classification.
